no_sites: No sites in {doc_root}. Create a project or copy a folder there.
hostname_hint: Use {name} for the folder name, e.g. {name}.test
bad_format: The format must include {name}, for example {name}.test.
bad_port: The port must be between 2 and 65535.
bad_name: The name can only have letters, numbers, - . and _.
after_download: A window is downloading the project. When it finishes, click Reload.
new_server_hint: Another server of the same kind, on its own port, running side by side.
name: Name
mysql_new_hint: An empty folder becomes a new MySQL (root without password). A folder with data is used as it is.
same_port: Two servers can not use the same port
data_kept: Its files and data stay where they are.
updates_hint: The newest stable version of each tool, from its official site. A new version goes in its own folder beside the old one; your settings and data are kept.
mysql_lts_hint: MySQL: the newest 8.4 (LTS), which opens the data you already have. MySQL 9 is not offered: it converts the data and there is no way back.
by_hand: no official ZIP, use the Download... button on its row
taken_windows_2: is held by a Windows service, so this server can not use it.
taken_fix_1: Before starting it, change its port in Preferences → Services & Ports;
admin_hint: Opens its page, its database tool or its command line
need_php: Admin of MySQL uses Adminer, which needs PHP: install PHP first.
serve_hint: Runs this site on a PHP server of its own, with the chosen version, on port
restart_site: Stop and start its server again to apply.
no_code: VS Code was not found (the 'code' command).
sites_hint_on: Apache is on: each site opens at its .test address. To try another PHP version, use Start server.
sites_hint_off: Start Apache to open the sites at their .test address, or use Start server to run one site alone.
restore_warn: The tables in the backup replace the ones with the same name in that database.
share_hint: A public https link to this site (Cloudflare quick tunnel, no account). Anyone with the link can open it.
share_started: opening a public link (a few seconds).
https_hint: Creates a local certificate authority (Windows asks to trust it, only for your user) and a certificate per site; Apache answers on 443.
xdebug_hint: Step debugging (port 9003, starts with the browser extension or XDEBUG_TRIGGER).
tray_note: Ninho keeps running in the tray, next to the clock. Right click it to quit.
close_to_tray: Closing the window keeps Ninho in the tray
qr_hint: Point the phone camera to open the link.
node_hint: Versions stay side by side. A project uses the one in its .nvmrc file (in its terminal).
project_done: Done - close this window; the site appears in Ninho.
own_templates: Your own templates go in etc\ninho-templates.json.
tray_hint: Tip: left click a site to open it.
install_app_hint: Copies Ninho to your user programs folder, adds it to the Start menu and to Windows Installed apps. No administrator rights. Your servers and sites stay where they are.
uninstall_hint: To remove it, use Windows Settings > Apps > Installed apps > Ninho. Your servers, databases and sites are kept.
portable_now: Running as a portable copy (settings beside Ninho.exe).
uninstall_done: Ninho was removed. Your servers, databases and sites were kept.
welcome_intro: Ninho runs Apache, PHP, MySQL and the other servers of your projects from one place. Choose where it keeps them and what to download now.
welcome_folder_hint: Programs go in bin, databases in data and your sites in www, all inside this folder. An existing Laragon folder works as it is.
welcome_pick: Download now (newest stable, from the official sites)
welcome_pick_hint: You can add the others later in Download and update.
crash_text: Ninho stopped because of an error. The details are in this file; please attach it when you report the problem:
check_updates: Check for a new Ninho when it opens
import_title: Import from XAMPP, WampServer or Laragon
import_intro: Copies your sites into Ninho's www folder and copies your databases into Ninho's MySQL. The old install is only read, never changed.
import_none: No XAMPP, WampServer or Laragon found on C: or D:.
import_password: MySQL root password of the old install
import_hint: Close the old XAMPP, WampServer or Laragon first. For databases, start Ninho's MySQL; tables with the same name in Ninho are replaced. A copy of the dump stays in the backups folder.
import_skipped: Sites left as they were (already in www or could not be copied):
log_cf_not_running: cloudflared.exe was downloaded but does not run
log_cf_place_failed: could not place cloudflared.exe; is a tunnel still running?
log_cf_too_small: the downloaded file is too small to be cloudflared
log_data_create_failed: could not create the data folder:
log_data_existing: your existing data will be used:
log_data_new: new data folder created (root without password):
log_data_not_empty: the folder is not empty and is not a data folder. Choose another.
log_hosts_asking: Asking Windows for permission to update the hosts file...
log_hosts_read_failed: Could not read the hosts file.
log_hosts_refused: The hosts file was not changed (permission refused).
log_hosts_tmp_failed: Could not write a temporary hosts file.
log_httpd_ok: httpd.conf set up for Ninho (server folder, www, PHP, .test sites).
log_https_on: HTTPS on: the .test sites answer at https://
log_https_trust_ask: Windows will ask to trust Ninho's local certificate authority (only for your user).
log_looking_newest: looking for the newest stable version...
log_move_failed: could not move the unpacked folder:
log_mysql_force_stop: Graceful shutdown failed. Did you change the root password? Forcing it to stop...
log_no_32bit: has no official 32-bit Windows build; use the 64-bit Ninho on a 64-bit Windows
log_no_pg_build: no Windows build of PostgreSQL found for version:
log_not_dll: the downloaded file is not a DLL
log_phpini_created: php.ini created from php.ini-development, with curl, gd, intl, mbstring, mysqli, openssl, pdo_mysql, sqlite and zip on.
log_port_busy_hint: It may be running under another process.
log_xdebug_installed: installed. You can turn it on now.
log_xdebug_looking: looking for a build for PHP
log_xdebug_no_build: Xdebug has no build for this PHP version yet:
log_xdebug_replace_failed: could not replace ext\php_xdebug.dll (stop Apache/PHP first):
already_running: Ninho is already open, maybe as administrator. Use that window or close it first.
import_after_start: After you click Start, Ninho offers to bring their sites and databases.
import_ninho_password: Root password of Ninho's MySQL (empty if you never set one)
import_replace: These databases already exist in Ninho and would be replaced:
port_in_use: port in use by another program
services_hint: Tick a server to show it in Modules. Its port and version are used the next time it starts.
db_password_hint: Leave it empty if the root user has no password.
import_need_db: Type the database name to import
end_text: End {exe} (PID {pid}) on port {port}? Anything unsaved in it is lost.
reach_hint: Network: other devices on your network can connect. This PC: only this computer can.
ports_filter: Filter by port, program or what it is
hosts_note: Windows will ask for permission to edit the hosts file.
admin_off_hint: Start the server to open it
no_modules: No server is shown in Modules.
import_none_here: Nothing to import in that folder.
h_apc_bad_fix: Open httpd.conf (Apache's Config button), fix the line shown and test again.
h_apc_nostart_fix: Check that Visual C++ is installed and that antivirus did not block httpd.exe.
h_apc_nostart_t: Apache did not open for the test
h_apc_pending_d: Ninho prepares httpd.conf at the first start; the syntax test runs after that.
h_disk_err_d: Almost out of space: MySQL may corrupt data and downloads will fail.
h_disk_err_fix: Free up space now on the drive where Ninho is.
h_disk_warn_d: Getting low; databases and logs grow over time.
h_disk_warn_fix: Free up space on the drive where Ninho is.
h_dup_d: {names} are on the same port; only one of them can start.
h_dup_fix: Give each server a different port in Settings.
h_extdir_bad_fix: Set extension_dir in php.ini to PHP's ext folder.
h_extdir_bad_t: extension_dir points to a folder that does not exist
h_extdir_none_d: Without this line PHP cannot find the extensions.
h_extdir_none_fix: In php.ini, keep the line extension_dir = "ext" without the semicolon.
h_exts_bad_d: Off or missing in php.ini: {list}. Many systems (WordPress, Laravel) need them.
h_exts_bad_fix: Turn them on in "PHP extensions" or remove the semicolon from the extension= line in php.ini.
h_guard_fix: Try again; if it repeats, see Ninho's activity.
h_hosts_a: To update it Ninho asks for administrator permission (this is normal).
h_hosts_ok_t: Hosts file up to date ({n} address(es))
h_hosts_read_d: {path} did not open for reading; .test addresses may not work.
h_hosts_read_fix: Check whether antivirus or another program is blocking the file.
h_hosts_read_t: Could not read the hosts file
h_hosts_sync_d: There are {want} site(s) in the folder, but {marked} Ninho line(s) in hosts. {access}
h_hosts_sync_fix: Open the Sites tab and refresh; accept the Windows permission prompt.
h_ini_none_d: Could not find {path}. Without it PHP runs with everything off (no mysqli, mbstring, curl...).
h_ini_none_fix: Copy php.ini-development to php.ini in the PHP folder.
h_mod_no_d: Only "Thread Safe" (TS) versions ship php*apache2_4.dll; without it Apache does not run .php files.
h_mod_no_fix: Download a Thread Safe (TS) PHP or use Ninho's built-in PHP server.
h_mod_no_t: The chosen PHP has no Apache module
h_mod_ok_d: The chosen PHP has the module to run inside Apache.
h_my_data_new_t: {name}: data folder will be created at first start
h_my_data_no_d:
my.ini points to {path}, which was not found.
MySQL does not start without it.
h_my_data_no_fix: Fix the datadir line in my.ini or recover the data folder.
h_my_data_no_t: {name}: the data folder does not exist
h_my_login_d: The server is up on port {port}, but {reason}.
h_my_login_fix: Ninho's create-database uses root without a password. If you set one, use your SQL client; otherwise see the MySQL log.
h_my_login_t: {name} did not accept the root login
h_my_nodd_d: Could not find the datadir line in this MySQL's my.ini.
h_my_q_d: Logged in as root, without a password, and SELECT 1 worked.
h_my_reason_conn: could not connect to the port
h_my_reason_pw: root has a password (Ninho expects root without a password)
h_none_d: All servers are off in Settings.
h_none_fix: Turn on at least Apache and MySQL.
h_notinst_fix: Download it in the "Download and update" window or turn this server off.
h_php_norun_d: php.exe did not answer the command "php -n -v".
h_php_norun_fix: Install Visual C++ 2015-2022 or download PHP again (antivirus may have blocked php.exe).
h_port_busy_d: Port {port} is already in use by {who}, so {name} cannot start.
h_port_busy_fix: Close that program (Ports tab) or change this server's port in Settings.
h_port_res_d: Windows set this port range aside (Hyper-V, WSL or Docker often do) and no program can open it.
h_port_res_fix: Choose another port for this server in Settings.
h_port_sys_d: Port {port} is held by {who}, which is part of Windows itself (low ports like 1025 are often its own).
h_port_sys_fix: Do not close that program: change this server's port in Settings.
h_site_no_fix: Create the folder or choose another in Settings.
h_tls_nocert_d: Ninho's local authority has not been created yet.
h_tls_nocert_fix: Refresh the sites (Sites tab) with Apache installed; it is created then.
h_tls_nocert_t: HTTPS is on, but there is no certificate
h_tls_untr_d: The browser will show an insecure-site warning on https addresses.
h_tls_untr_fix: Use "Trust the certificate" in the HTTPS settings.
h_tls_untr_t: HTTPS: Windows does not trust the certificate yet
h_vc_miss_d: Missing from Windows: {files}. Without them Apache, PHP and PostgreSQL will not open.
h_vc_ok_d: Apache, PHP and PostgreSQL need it, and it is present.
home_no_sites: No sites yet. Create a folder in your www folder, then refresh the sites in Ninho.
home_your_files: You have your own index file in the www folder. This page is shown here; your file is at
home_footer: This page is made by Ninho and written again when the sites refresh or the servers start.
